assessments.reasoning: The publication metadata directly assigns Candidate Recommendation Draft status. The exact draft title, status paragraph and W3C publication history agree. Membership in the Recommendation track does not by itself establish final maturity. The status section’s older minimum-candidate date does not identify the publication date.

limitations: The status is an edition-specific classification. Current maturity, later publications, Recommendation approval and implementation availability are outside this record.
